note: 'By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD ... I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore' (Gen 22:16-17). Hebrews 11:12 counts the promise as kept in the same two images, stars and sand.

'Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him, said the angel, for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me' (Gen 22:12), called out of heaven after the knife is already in his hand (22:10).
Abraham names the place at 22:14; the land it stands in is named at 22:2, 'go to the land of Moriah ... on one of the mountains, which I will show you'.
